subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): guard ingress effects once per event

question: Should `createIngressEffectOnce` become a supported public Plugin SDK API now, or should the claim/commit sequence remain channel-owned until the first durable-ingress adoption establishes a stable shared contract?
rationale: The PR is additive but creates a compatibility-sensitive Plugin SDK surface; repository policy requires maintainer-visible judgment on whether this is the permanent public boundary.

options.title: Approve the public SDK seam
options.body: Keep the new subpath and factory as the shared contract after accepting its documented failure and replay semantics.

options.title: Keep the primitive owner-local for now
options.body: Defer the SDK export and let the first adopting channel use the existing persistent-dedupe primitive until common channel needs stabilize.

recommendation.title: Approve the public SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the new subpath and factory as the shared contract after accepting its documented failure and replay semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR evidence identifies steipete as the current owner of the proposed API; broader ownership history could not be established from the sandbox.
